purpose: Teach: 好ましい/分かち/動かさ/限る/だまさ/近頃/さよなら/ボロ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの態度、好ましい子供でいたいよ、これからも。
lines.en: Mom, I want to keep being a good kid. I really do.
lines.style: Soft, sincere opening. No performance—just a child speaking what matters to him. Slight pause after 'Mom,' as if checking she's listening. Steady pace. Eyes up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃんと、お菓子、分かち合うのは、いいことね。
lines.en: Yes. And sharing sweets with Grandpa—that's a good thing.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, not effusive. Gentle nod in her voice. The rhythm of agreement that feels like she's been thinking the same thing. Reassuring without making it a big deal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 重い荷物、ぼく、動かさないようにね、ママ、危ないって。
lines.en: Heavy things—I won't move them, Mom. You said it's dangerous.
lines.style: Careful, protective tone. Child being responsible—not bossy, but sincere about the rule. Slight emphasis on 'dangerous' without drama, like he's remembering the warning and holding it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏休みのおやつ、アイスに限るわね、暑い日は。
lines.en: Ice cream really is the best snack when it's this hot, isn't it.
lines.style: Practical observation wrapped in contentment. Soft, almost musing. The voice of someone enjoying a simple truth on a summer day. Slight trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達に、だまされちゃダメだよって、ママ、いつも言うね。
lines.en: You always tell me not to let friends trick me, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. Child processing something his mother has said—not complaining, just noticing the pattern. Gentle, thinking-out-loud quality. No accusation, just remembering.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 近頃、翔くん、自分で、お着替え、できるようになったわね、すごい。
lines.en: You know, lately Sho's been able to change his own clothes. That's amazing.
lines.style: Genuine pride in his growth. Soft, observant tone—she's noticed something real about him. Not condescending, but the warmth of a mother marking a milestone. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達と、さよなら、寂しいよね、夏休み終わりに。
lines.en: Saying goodbye to friends at the end of summer break—it's sad, isn't it.
lines.style: Wistful, small voice. Child expressing something that aches a little. No big emotion—just honest. Pace slows slightly. The kind of sadness that's tender and true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、ボロボロの倉庫、まだあるかしら、覚えてる?
lines.en: Do you remember that old, falling-apart storage shed at Grandpa's?
lines.style: Searching memory, gentle distance in the voice. Wistful turning backward. Soft, wondering tone—checking if she remembers too. Opens into quiet nostalgia, not pushing.
